c.v: The ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 is an entry-level development board equipped with ESP32-S3-WROOM-1, ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U, or ESP32-S3-WROOM-2, a general-purpose
+ Bluetooth® Low Energy MCU module that integrates complete Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Low Energy functions.
Most of the I/O pins on the module are broken out to the pin headers on both sides of this board for easy interfacing.
Developers can either connect peripherals with jumper wires or mount ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 on a breadboard.
This section (version v1.1 of the board) provides a brief introduction of ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, instructions on how to do the initial hardware setup and how to flash firmware onto it.
